text:
serena: Quick design review — I'm worried the new compact "variant delta" pill makes it hard to tell which canary changed vs which is active. saw it on staging and had to hover every pill.

kai: good call. can you paste a screenshot? I think the small chevron + color alone might not be enough.

serena: pasted a screenshot in thread (see staging: /s/rollout/variant-compact). main issues: small contrast between +5% and 0% text, caret direction ambiguous with multiple stacked variants, and screen-reader reads only 'variant 2' — no delta.

mike: oof. i also noticed keyboard focus outline gets lost when you have 4 variants compressed. Tab order jumps are weird.

olga: accessibility nit: SR should announce change like 'Variant Beta: increased by 5 percent, now 25 percent of traffic'. Right now it's silent. We should use aria-live="polite" for the delta when the rollout updates.

serena: yeah exactly. also copy question: should the inline delta be "+5%" or "+5 pts"? Designers prefer % but PMs worried about rounding confusion for tiny mobile allocations.

kai: prefer percent. it's familiar. for <1% we can show '<1%'. avoid 'pts'.

mike: proposal: widen pill min-width, move delta to the right with subtle background (low-contrast chip), and add a thin vertical indicator when it's the latest change. that keeps density but improves scannability.

olga: +1 for vertical indicator, but ensure color contrast meets 4.5:1. if the indicator is purely decorative, add an additional textual cue for SR.

serena: about rollback panic — current red 'Rollback' button label in the flyout reads very alarming. UX asked for 'Rollback to previous' vs 'Panic rollback'. PMs think 'Rollback to previous version' is clearer. Thoughts?

kai: prefer 'Rollback to previous version' — less dramatic, clearer about scope. and add confirm modal with keyboard focus trap. The modal confirm button should be the primary action and accessible via Enter.

mike: for the timeline scrubber: tactile feedback on hover is making timeline flicker. reduce hover motion; prefer instant highlight without translate Y. Motion reduction toggle for people who opt out?

olga: yes. put prefers-reduced-motion hook and default to no translate. Also add focus-visible styles for keyboard users (2px dashed outline) so it doesn't rely on hover color alone.

design-bot: ACTIONS: serena to iterate mockup with wider pill and right-aligned delta; olga to write SR copy for delta announcements; kai to validate keyboard order; mike to test reduced-motion. Due: EOD Friday. :memo:

serena: I'll push two variations — one with right-aligned delta + vertical change bar, another with slightly taller pills and left caret showing 'active' variant. I'll include an a11y spec for aria-live text.

kai: when you post mocks, include the CSS tokens or tailwind classes you used so eng can prototype quickly.

mike: dev note: if we add aria-live updates, make sure we debounce rapid allocations to avoid spamming SR. maybe batch within 1s.

olga: agreed. and include examples for when allocation goes from 0 -> 1% (says 'now 1 percent of traffic') and 1% -> 0 (says 'removed from traffic'). clarity for negative deltas matters.

serena: cool — will post mocks by tomorrow morning. thanks all. :raised_hands:
